notes:
## Changes

- **One "Refresh folders"** in the Collection menu replaces "Refresh folders on show" and "Refresh all folders". With no search or filter on, it refreshes every folder on your connected drives. With one on, it asks whether to refresh just the folders on show or all of them.
- **Folder tiles are less cluttered.** Each tile shows one date: when the folder was added, or when it was last updated if you sort by latest release. The drive name only appears when your folders are on more than one drive, or when that drive isn't connected.
- **Thin, themed scroll bars** in light mode too, matching dark mode.
- **Find by face** scores now say what they mean, such as "Likely · 82%" or "Maybe · 61%", instead of relying on colour alone.
- **Problem counts** in Refresh folder contents, the refresh summary, Rebuild all screenshots and Backup now show a warning sign beside them when something needs attention.
- The **Collection editor** has been removed.

## Fixes

- Refreshing "folders on show" now really refreshes only the folders your search and filters show. Before, it refreshed them all.
- The Problems count in Refresh folder contents is no longer shown in red when it's 0.
